title: The Polya-Tchebotarov problem
key_result: Described numerical methods for solving the Polya-Chebotarev problem and connected it to Bloch-Landau constant bounds.

title: The Polya-Chebotarev problem and inverse polynomial images
key_result: Connected the Polya-Chebotarev problem to inverse polynomial images.

title: Sets of Minimal Capacity and Extremal Domains
key_result: Proved unique existence theorem for extremal domains and their complementary sets of minimal capacity.

title: Zolotarev's conformal mapping and Chebotarev's problem
key_result: Connected Zolotarev's conformal mapping to the Chebotarev problem.
